# CVN Z790M FROZEN D5 V20

## CVN Z790M FROZEN D5 V20

- CVN series customized white motherboard
- CVN series customized frost cooling armor
- PCIe slot custom metal armor
- 12+1 phase digital power supply design (Dr MOS 55A)
- Provides 3 PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 SSD slots
- Provide one USB 3.2 Gen 2 10Gbps Type-C and one USB 3.2 Gen 2 10Gbps Type-A high-speed rear interface
- Equipped with Realtek 2.5G high-speed wired network card and AX201 WiFi 6 wireless network card, supporting Bluetooth 5.1
- Support the iGame Center light efficiency control software, which can synchronously adjust the light efficiency of the radiator, cooling fan and memory
- The I/O panel supports one click BIOS upgrade
- Support AMD CrossFire ™ technology
- Six protection technologies, more stable product operation
- 200 processes are strictly tested with guaranteed quality
- PCB atomization process comprehensively upgraded
- “410” high-quality service and guaranteed after-sales service

| Motherboard Series | CVN Series |
| --- | --- |
| Chipset | Intel Z790 |
| Processor | Support the 13th and 12th generation Intel adapting to the LGA 1700 slot of the motherboard ® Core TM, Pentium ® And Cylon ® processor |
| Memory | 4 DDR5 memory sockets are provided, which can support up to 128 GB of memory (a single socket can support up to 32 GB of memory). Support DDR5-6400 (OC)/6200 (OC)/6000 (OC)/5800 (OC)/5600 (OC)/5400 (OC)/5200 (OC)/5000 (OC)/4800MHz memory, Extreme Memory Profile (XMP) memory technology, and dual channel memory technology |
| SATA Ports | 3 M.2 slots and 6 SATA 6Gb/s hard disk interfaces. M.2_1 slot: support 2242/2280 specification M.2 SSD (PCIe 4.0 x4, CPU channel), M.2_2/M.2_3 slots: support 2242/2260/2280 M.2 SSD (PCIe 4.0 x4, PCH channel) |
| Board I/O | Rear I/O: 1×USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C interface; 1×USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A interface; 2×USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A interfaces; 4×USB 2.0 interfaces; 1×DP 1.2 interface, supporting a maximum resolution of 4K 60Hz; 1×HDMI 2.0 interface, supporting up to 4K 60Hz resolution; 1×2.5G network interface; 3×audio interfaces; 2×WiFi 6 antenna interfaces; 1×BIOS update key. On board: 1×USB 2.0 pins; 1×USB 3.2 Gen 1 pin; 1×USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C slot; 1×CPU fan pin; 3×system fan pins; 1×water cooling pump pin; 2×5V 3-pin ARGB pins; 2×12V 4-pin RGB pins; 1×front audio pin; 1×front panel pin; 1×spraker pin; 1×CMOS clearing key; 1×serial port contact pin; 1×BIOS burner pin; 1×POST card pin; 1×ME write protection jumper; 1×RGB light effect control jumper |
| Expansion Slots | 1×PCIe 5.0 x16 slot; 1×PCIe 3.0 x4 slots |
| BIOS | 128M UEFI, support multiple languages |
| Power Management | Support S3/S4 wake-up, network S5 wake-up, support USB wake-up, support timing boot, call boot |
| Hardware Monitor | CPU Fan speed Controlled，SYSTEM Fan speed Monitoring,CPU Temperature Monitoring，System Temperature Monitoring，and Voltage monitoring |
| LAN | RTL8125 2.5Gbit LAN |
| Audio | 5.1-Channel High Definition audio CODEC |
| Configuration | 245 x 245 mm，M-ATX |
